prohibited_terms.reason: Insurance policies cannot guarantee investment returns; only licensed investment products may do so.
prohibited_terms.legal_reference: IPEC Circular 5 of 2018 — Misleading Marketing Practices

prohibited_terms.reason: Guaranteeing no-claims bonuses in policy documents is misleading as it depends on future claims experience.
prohibited_terms.legal_reference: Insurance Act Section 19(2) — Misleading Policy Terms

prohibited_terms.reason: All insurance policies must state defined limits of liability; 'unlimited' coverage is prohibited under Section 15(1)(c).
Blanket 'all risks' statements without specifying exclusions are misleading under IPEC consumer protection guidelines.
Only IPEC-registered insurers may underwrite policies in Zimbabwe. References to unregistered entities are prohibited.
prohibited_terms.legal_reference: Insurance Act Section 7 — Registration of Insurers

prohibited_terms.reason: Clauses that waive the insurer's right of subrogation against the insured for intentional acts are prohibited.
Retroactive coverage that is not explicitly disclosed and agreed upon at policy inception is prohibited.
Policies cannot automatically renew without providing advance written notice to the insured.
prohibited_terms.legal_reference: Insurance Act Section 35(3) — Renewal Notice Requirements

prohibited_terms.reason: Exclusions based on race, gender, disability, or religion are prohibited under Zimbabwe's Constitution and insurance law.
prohibited_terms.legal_reference: Constitution of Zimbabwe Section 56 & Insurance Act Section 20

prohibited_terms.term: foreign currency clause without RBZ approval
prohibited_terms.reason: Policies denominated or payable in foreign currency require Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe (RBZ) approval.
Insurance premiums must be collected by IPEC-licensed brokers or directly by the insurer.
Open-ended claims settlement obligations without a defined period are prohibited as they create unquantifiable liabilities.
